openings:
The strongest opening is the say and do gap: it sells paid search, paid social and CRO, and its own house contradicts all three (no Google ads of its own, no social pixel, no testing tool), with P4 partial. A rival that runs its own ads, shows a pixel and a test tool on its own site and brings measurement depth very likely (moderate confidence) takes paid media and CRO accounts such as Simon Pearce and Klassy Network, the accounts KJ5 prices down first. Falsifier: Google ads under its own name in the Transparency Center, or a social pixel and a testing tool detected on singlegrain.com at the next compile.

Second, the headcount promise without a price: it sells pipeline without adding headcount and lists no pricing model (P5 unknown); an outcome priced offer with a public rate likely (low confidence) wins the mid market end of a mixed book.

Third, its lead line is defensible (460 AI URLs, an llms.txt, 2026-01-12 citation studies, P1 partial), so a rival should not lead there; the contestable gap is P2, absent: no feed, schema or entity work, so the machine readable layer under its AEO claims is unclaimed (likely, low confidence). The 7 names only are the questions to ask its clients.
